page.title: Templates
page.subtitle: Browse, create, and share mind map templates

desktop_signin.title: Sign in for community templates
desktop_signin.description: Browse and use templates shared by the NeuroCanvas community.

ai_bar.title: Generate with AI
ai_bar.description: Describe what you need and AI will create a template structure
ai_bar.example: e.g. "SWOT analysis for a SaaS product"

empty_state.title: No templates found
empty_state.description: Try a different category or search term

ai_adapt_modal.title: AI Adapt Template
ai_adapt_modal.description: {title} will be customized to your topic
ai_adapt_modal.error_no_credential: Add an AI API key in Settings → AI Providers to use AI adaptation.
ai_adapt_modal.error_failed: Couldn't adapt the template. Try again.

publish_modal.title: Publish Template
publish_modal.description: Share your map structure with the community
publish_modal.describe_template: Describe what this template is for...

swot-analysis.title: SWOT Analysis
swot-analysis.description: Analyze your project, product, or business using the SWOT framework. Identify internal strengths and weaknesses, then map external opportunities and threats. AI adapts the structure to your specific topic.

brainstorm.title: Brainstorm
brainstorm.description: Free-form idea generation with radial branches. Start with a central idea and expand outward with related thoughts and concepts.

study-notes.title: Study Notes
study-notes.description: Hierarchical topic breakdown with key concepts and details. Organize your learning material into structured, reviewable sections.

project-plan.title: Project Plan
project-plan.description: Phased project breakdown with tasks and milestones. Structure your project into clear phases with actionable tasks.

competitor-analysis.title: Competitor Analysis
competitor-analysis.description: Compare competitors across features, pricing, and positioning. Map the competitive landscape to identify opportunities.

research-paper.title: Research Paper
research-paper.description: Structure a thesis with arguments, evidence, and conclusions. Organize your research paper sections from abstract to conclusion.

pros-and-cons.title: Pros & Cons
pros-and-cons.description: Balanced decision-making with weighted arguments. Visually compare the advantages and disadvantages of any choice.

sprint-retro.title: Sprint Retro
sprint-retro.description: What went well, what didn't, and action items. Structure your sprint retrospective for productive team reflection.

cornell-notes.title: Cornell Notes
cornell-notes.description: The classic Cornell note-taking layout — cues on the left, detailed notes on the right, summary at the bottom. Designed for retention, not just transcription.

concept-map.title: Concept Map
concept-map.description: Connect concepts with labelled relationships. Used in education research to expose understanding, not just facts.

lesson-plan.title: Lesson Plan
lesson-plan.description: Structure a class around objectives, activities, and assessment — explicit, sequenced, and time-boxed.

flashcard-set.title: Flashcard Set
flashcard-set.description: Build a study set as a tree — categories at level one, term/definition pairs as leaves. Export to Anki-style review later.

okr-tree.title: OKR Tree
okr-tree.description: One company-level objective, supporting team objectives, and measurable key results under each. Ladder up to strategy, not vanity metrics.

business-model-canvas.title: Business Model Canvas
business-model-canvas.description: Nine building blocks of a business — value, customers, channels, costs. The Osterwalder canvas, hierarchical for fast iteration.

go-to-market.title: Go-to-Market Plan
go-to-market.description: Position, target, channels, pricing — a launch plan that survives contact with a real market.

story-arc.title: Story Arc
story-arc.description: Three-act story structure with rising action, climax, and resolution. Map plot beats before you write a word of prose.

character-bible.title: Character Bible
character-bible.description: Build a character from the inside out — backstory, motivation, voice, arc. The bible you never break.

songwriting.title: Song Structure
songwriting.description: Verse, chorus, bridge, hook — sketch a song as a tree before recording. Genre-agnostic skeleton.

eisenhower-matrix.title: Eisenhower Matrix
eisenhower-matrix.description: Urgent vs important — sort tasks into Do, Schedule, Delegate, Drop. Cuts through the false-urgency trap.

weekly-review.title: Weekly Review
weekly-review.description: GTD-style weekly review — what shipped, what stalled, what next. Process before you plan.

event-planner.title: Event Planner
event-planner.description: Logistics, content, and attendees mapped into one place. Catch the dependency you forgot in the spreadsheet.

literature-review.title: Literature Review
literature-review.description: Group sources by theme, surface gaps, and trace the conversation across papers. The map your supervisor actually wants.

user-interview.title: User Interview
user-interview.description: Plan a research interview — goals, questions, follow-ups. The script that doesn't feel like a script.

experiment-design.title: Experiment Design
experiment-design.description: Hypothesis, variables, controls, metrics. Frame an experiment so the result actually changes a decision.
